tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live job openings across India, checked at official employer sources. India only — non-Indian locations return no results. Returns up to 20 jobs per call with title, company, location, and a jobvetta URL.

location.description: Indian city, town, or state (India only)

days.description: Only jobs posted within the last N days (e.g. 2)

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details for one job (description, qualifications, salary, metadata) by job_id from search_jobs.
